statements.action_statement: The SHA-256-pinned official FFmpeg 9.0.2 archive contains upstream fix 65b0dab903e5975e036b30ecc58f5935d4f151e0: libavformat/dashdec.c clamps negative cur_seq_no and checks cur_seq_no >= 0 before fragments indexing. https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/65b0dab903e5975e036b30ecc58f5935d4f151e0

The SHA-256-pinned official FFmpeg 9.0.2 archive contains upstream fix 9d786e4b5e9b8482651928574de33772aeee7be1: libavformat/mpegenc.c rejects get_system_header_size(ctx) > 128 - 14 during mpeg_mux_init. https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/9d786e4b5e9b8482651928574de33772aeee7be1

The SHA-256-pinned official FFmpeg 9.0.2 archive contains upstream fix 983dae9c19f46c87d597598c0fd2f2fcee0ad2f8: libavformat/rtpenc_av1.c consumes LEB bytes then rejects obu_size > (uint32_t) rem_size before advancing the payload pointer. https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/983dae9c19f46c87d597598c0fd2f2fcee0ad2f8
